description: Defines static class AssetChildFlows with methods for managing asset-related child resources such as status logs, additional asset IDs, properties, mappings, and data input values in a data asset management system.

classes.name: AssetChildFlows
classes.description: Contains static methods providing workflows for managing asset child resources such as status logs, additional asset IDs, properties, mappings, and data input values.

methods.name: CreateAssetStatusLogAsync
methods.description: Creates a new status log entry for a specific asset after validation.

methods.name: ListAssetStatusLogsAsync
methods.description: Retrieves all status logs for a specific asset.

methods.name: GetAssetStatusLogByIdAsync
methods.description: Fetches a specific asset status log by its ID, confirming it belongs to the asset.

methods.name: UpdateAssetStatusLogAsync
methods.description: Updates a specific asset status log, ensuring date chronology rules.

methods.name: CreateAdditionalAssetIdAsync
methods.description: Adds a new alternative asset ID under an asset.

methods.name: ListAdditionalAssetIdsAsync
methods.description: Lists all additional asset IDs associated with an asset.

methods.name: GetAdditionalAssetIdByIdAsync
methods.description: Retrieves a specific additional asset ID record.

methods.name: UpdateAdditionalAssetIdAsync
methods.description: Updates an existing additional asset ID.

methods.name: CreateAssetPropertyAsync
methods.description: Creates an asset property for an asset.

methods.name: ListAssetPropertiesAsync
methods.description: Lists all properties linked to an asset.

methods.name: GetAssetPropertyByIdAsync
methods.description: Fetches a specific asset property by ID.

methods.name: UpdateAssetPropertyAsync
methods.description: Updates an asset property by ID.

methods.name: CreateControlDeviceMappingAsync
methods.description: Creates a control device mapping under an asset.

methods.name: ListControlDeviceMappingsAsync
methods.description: Lists control device mappings associated with an asset.

methods.name: GetControlDeviceMappingByIdAsync
methods.description: Retrieves a specific control device mapping by ID.

methods.name: UpdateControlDeviceMappingAsync
methods.description: Updates a control device mapping by ID.

methods.name: CreateInputParameterAsync
methods.description: Creates an input parameter for an asset.

methods.name: ListInputParametersAsync
methods.description: Lists all input parameters for an asset.

methods.name: GetInputParameterByIdAsync
methods.description: Retrieves a specific input parameter by ID.

methods.name: UpdateInputParameterAsync
methods.description: Updates an input parameter by ID.

methods.name: CreateParentInputMappingAsync
methods.description: Creates a parent input mapping for a child input parameter, ensuring hierarchy validity.

methods.name: ListParentInputMappingsAsync
methods.description: Lists parent input mappings for a given child input parameter.

methods.name: UpdateParentInputMappingAsync
methods.description: Updates a parent input mapping, validating hierarchy constraints.

methods.name: CreateReportingAttributeMappingAsync
methods.description: Creates a reporting attribute mapping, ensuring no duplicate combination within the asset.

methods.name: ListReportingAttributeMappingsAsync
methods.description: Lists reporting attribute mappings for an asset.

methods.name: GetReportingAttributeMappingByIdAsync
methods.description: Retrieves a specific reporting attribute mapping by ID.

methods.name: UpdateReportingAttributeMappingAsync
methods.description: Updates a reporting attribute mapping, checking for duplicate attribute combinations.

methods.name: CreateEfSourceMappingAsync
methods.description: Creates an EF source mapping under an asset for a specified input parameter, with validation.

methods.name: ListEfSourceMappingsAsync
methods.description: Lists EF source mappings associated with an input parameter under an asset.

methods.name: GetThroughputEquationAsync
methods.description: Retrieves a throughput equation linked to an input parameter.

methods.name: CreateThroughputEquationAsync
methods.description: Creates a throughput equation for an input parameter.

methods.name: UpdateThroughputEquationAsync
methods.description: Updates a throughput equation for an input parameter.

methods.name: CreateThroughputScalarAsync
methods.description: Creates a throughput scalar associated with a throughput equation and input parameter.

methods.name: ListThroughputScalarsAsync
methods.description: Lists all throughput scalars for an input parameter and throughput equation.

methods.name: UpdateThroughputScalarAsync
methods.description: Updates a throughput scalar for an input parameter.

methods.name: GetThroughputScalarByIdAsync
methods.description: Retrieves a scalar by ID, confirming it's under the hierarchy.

methods.name: DeleteThroughputScalarAsync
methods.description: Soft-deletes a throughput scalar, ensuring correct hierarchy and passing delete info.

methods.name: CreateDataInputValueAsync
methods.description: Creates a data input value for a specific input parameter.

methods.name: ListDataInputValuesAsync
methods.description: Lists all data input values for a specific input parameter.

methods.name: UpdateDataInputValueAsync
methods.description: Updates a data input value by ID.
